implementation.name: Atari2600 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 16 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 13 vhdl) alongside 19 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Atari 2600, giving machine_id a2600. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: the two license statements in the repository disagree. https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Atari2600_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE.txt is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Atari2600_MiSTer/blob/master/Atari2600.sv offers the work under GPL version 2 or later. Either reading is arguable and neither is a fact the repository states, so no SPDX id is asserted. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 16 source files (1 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 13 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. The repository is archived on GitHub and no longer maintained.
